query.description: Artist or project name (or part of it). / Nazwa artysty.

name: search_artists

ranking_position.description: Place in the TopAI chart; null = not ranked.

interpreted_as.description: Name used after correcting a typo.

note.description: Guidance for answering, e.g. when nothing was found.
